Real OSV records, copied unchanged from OSV's per-ecosystem dumps
(https://osv-vulnerabilities.storage.googleapis.com/<Ecosystem>/all.zip, 6 October 2026) for the
advisory engine's tests:

- `GHSA-*`: the GitHub Advisory Database (https://github.com/github/advisory-database), CC-BY 4.0.
- `PYSEC-*`: the Python Packaging Advisory Database (https://github.com/pypa/advisory-database),
  CC-BY 4.0.
- `GO-*`: the Go Vulnerability Database (https://vuln.go.dev), CC-BY 4.0.
- `MAL-*`: the OpenSSF Malicious Packages repository (https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages),
  Apache-2.0.
